findings.title: Named invalid-source control can credit a failure before actual compilation
findings.evidence: Custody increments compilerCalls before delegating; its named failure accepts a nonempty expectedFailure, one wrapper call, absent StageNative, retained private context and retained-files enumeration. Observer similarly accepts any delegated helper exception with failureInjected and retained context. Neither predicate requires actual compiler terminal evidence. Source sets InvocationStarted before exclusive source/diagnostic writes, Process.Start and WaitForExit; that field is not evidence of a started compiler process.
findings.causalExample: A source/output CreateNew failure or compiler Process.Start failure in the compile-failure case leaves no StageNative and a retained-compilation-failed context; current assertions can classify that as the intended invalid-C# rejection. This is a static counterexample, not a claimed native reproduction.
findings.requiredCorrection: PS5.1 must bind the exact written invalid native.cs bytes and nonempty raw compiler diagnostics to a non-null nonzero CompilerExitCode recorded after actual child termination, with the healthy actual compiler route paired. PS7 must attribute the exception to the real delegated Add-Type compilation for the exact invalid source, not any helper/setup exception. Preserve acquisition failures separately.
findings.rootResponse: Root accepted the gap and is adding PS5.1 terminal/raw-source evidence and a real Add-Type error observer on PS7 before native replay.

checks.result: All three new helpers begin with DryRun refusal. Static comparison and writer received actual guard-only controls agree; no normal/native compiler execution credited.

Existing native declarations and handle access/share policy are preserved. Reading is separated from directory opening without dropping disk/reparse/physical-path/ACL checks. Length/link fields use the existing BY_HANDLE_FILE_INFORMATION offsets. Directory caller retains directory-only refusal and handle disposal on failure.

Both PS and C# retain the full 0x500d0156 write-authority mask, rather than the weaker ancestor mask. Unknown/callback ACEs and null DACL set WriteRestricted false; owner and reparse checks remain separate. Existing ordinary C# projections were byte-identical after mechanically removing only the added WriteRestricted fact.

User and token default Owner are captured from one disposed identity object. Only same user or Administrators default owner is accepted; the self-owned compiler root still requires Private. Only compiler descendants gain the captured owner alternative. No ordinary artifact owner/admission rule changes.

Requires the same script context reference, compiling status, first invocation, live root/ancestor leases, fresh private root identity, exact TEMP/TMP confinement and empty root before source creation. InvocationStarted is attempt state only.

NativeSource is the existing literal. It is encoded as UTF-8 BOM bytes, exclusively created inside the owned root, read through a native lease denying writes/deletion and byte-hash/length checked before invocation. No shell/PATH compiler selection or external fallback is introduced.

PS5.1 selects runtime-directory csc, explicit System.dll, noconfig, explicit private output/working/TEMP/TMP paths, raw binary output capture, bounded wait and terminal exit check. Exact Windows behavior remains unexecuted by this reviewer.

Output must be an immediate child of the same live context, no alias/reparse, regular single-link with captured owner and full write restriction. DLL bytes are size-bounded, read from a held deny-write/delete handle, identity/length/readback checked and byte-loaded; expected type is required. File-backed LoadFrom is absent.

Exceptions propagate to unchanged outer environment restoration and failed-context retention. Diagnostic/source/assembly handles are disposed. A termination failure is warned and retained; it is not ready/admitted evidence.

Root remains self-owned/private with original identity; every enumerated descendant must have the supported captured owner and full write restriction, regular files one link, identity reread before deletion. Descendant/root leases are released only for deletion while original ancestor leases remain held. Native adversarial cleanup must still establish this behavior.

PS7 retains Add-Type inside the admitted helper. All functions from Get-StagingUserSid onward are byte-identical to f801; only the new C# fact is added to the earlier native payload. Original artifact/discovery/selector/entry behavior is not requalified by this comparison.

testIntegrationReview.sameReferenceDelegation: Both wrappers capture the actual source helper before replacing the function and call it with the original Context object. Observer New-StagingCompilerContext wrapper returns the original object without a reconstruction. Healthy source is unchanged; only the named compile-failure appends explicit invalid text.
testIntegrationReview.failureInjection: Actual source/helper/C# hashes and same-reference observation improve attribution; intended compiler-terminal evidence is the open finding above.
testIntegrationReview.eventBoundaries: Readiness and before/after boundaries retain PID, nonce, source hash, cold types and owned-root facts. Before/after barriers drain the watched TEMP events while original custody remains live; postcompiler readback precedes release into the later artifact-parent checks. Watcher error/timeout/snapshot or boundary failure prevents acquisition. No changed event-phase or path-containment classifier found.
testIntegrationReview.observationLimits: The watcher observes the verified TEMP/TMP subtree, not global process activity. Asynchronous event drain is an observation boundary. The 25-second observer window does not qualify the source helper 60-second timeout/termination path. OBSERVATIONS_ACQUIRED remains separate from product qualification.
testIntegrationReview.currentCompatibility: The tests require new Invoke-StagingCompiler and context fields and match frozen ab2d847 signatures. They cannot qualify unchanged f801. Later test derivatives must be hash-rebound after the oracle repair.
testIntegrationReview.otherExistingAssertions: Seven native custody cases, guarded-parent mutant/healthy pair, native refusal paths, root lease rename proof, useful normal staging and retained lifetime remain present. No broad assertion removal was introduced in these diffs.
